The '''''Panther Star''''' was a ship in the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet]] that fought and was destroyed at the [[Battle of Centerpoint Station (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Centerpoint Station]]. It was under the command of a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]].
